title: STILL PRESENT (r1): W8 late-response guard still never checks the route — a stale action response toasts on any non-detail page because application_detail is not cleared off-route
detail: find_refcheck_call matches the still-loaded application_detail; BrowserChangedUrl (client.gleam:662-680) clears detail only in the ApplicationDetail branch, so navigating to dashboard leaves Success(detail) and the stale Ok/Error still toasts there. Only refetch_refcheck_effect is route-guarded.
recommended_fix: Guard the handler on model.route being the same ApplicationDetail(vid, aid) the action fired from (store vid/aid on fire), or clear application_detail on every non-detail route change.

title: Substitute edit-trio prefills the terminal referee's own contact and the server accepts an identical trio — saving unchanged (or partially edited) re-contacts an objected/unreachable person, routing around the Art 21 hard stop (FR-RC10 requires 'a different referee')
detail: Both substitute entry points (menu on unreachable, body button on objected) open the §8.3 trio prefilled with the OLD referee's details; validation passes untouched, and do_substitute/substitute_reference_call.sql perform no old-vs-new contact comparison, so a fresh live row re-invites the objector/non-responder.
recommended_fix: Start the substitute trio blank (correct keeps the prefill), and/or reject server-side a substitute whose effective trio equals the old row's contact (same-contact = 409).

title: STILL PRESENT (r1): N9 spec Files section still names files that don't exist under those names and miscounts new vs edited SQL
detail: No update_application_referee_trio.sql exists (three per-slot files: update_application_referee_trio_character/employer/landlord.sql); no reference_panel_actions_test.gleam exists (tests live in reference_panel_test.gleam); find_reference_call_by_send_ref.sql and get_form_context_by_form_token.sql are NEW this PR, not edits.

title: STILL PRESENT (r1): N10 substitute SQL re-implements the live-slot idempotent insert — the ON CONFLICT live-status predicate is now maintained in three places
evidence:
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO reference_call (
    application_id, ref_slot, owner_label,
    contact_name, contact_email, contact_phone,
    next_attempt_at
  )
  SELECT application_id, ref_slot, owner_label,
         $3, NULLIF($4, ''), NULLIF($5, ''),
         now()
  FROM guard
  ON CONFLICT (application_id, ref_slot, owner_label) WHERE status NOT IN (
    'form_completed', 'unreachable', 'refused', 'objected',
    'manual_recorded', 'failed', 'completed', 'partial'
  )
detail: The identical live-status predicate now lives in the migration index (20260731222000:138), insert_reference_call_if_absent.sql:28-31, and here — any future status-set change must touch all three or the ON CONFLICT inference silently breaks.
recommended_fix: Either reuse insert_reference_call_if_absent semantics (compose in Gleam), or extract the predicate into a shared SQL fragment/comment with a drift-pinning test.
